mentions.name: Bebilog
mentions.description: Bebilog is an iOS app that tracks a baby's status, built by a new father whose son was born premature. All data stays on-device and is never sent to third parties.
mentions.problem: The author's son was born premature and the family is worried; they wanted a way to track the baby's status without sending his data to any third party.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just became a father and feel like it could be helpful if I have an app tracking my son's status. He has premature birth and we're all very worried about him.

I don't want my son's data to be sent to any 3rd party so I vibe coded: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bebilog/id6759827652
